#47 #1183  CVE-2026-41080 -- The existing hash flooding protection
                    (based on SipHash) only used 4 to 8 bytes of entropy for
                    a salt, when 16 bytes of salt are supported by the
                    implementation of SipHash used by Expat. Now full 16 bytes
                    of entropy are used to improve protection against hash
                    flooding attacks.
                      Existing API function XML_SetHashSalt is now deprecated
                    because of its limitations, and its use should be
                    considered a vulnerability. Please either use the new API
                    function XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes (with known-high-quality
                    entropy input only!) instead, or leave the derivation of
                    a 16-bytes hash salt from high quality entropy to Expat's
                    internal machinery (by *not* calling either of the two
                    XML_SetHashSalt* functions).

Sets the hash salt to use for internal hash calculations. Helps in preventing DoS attacks based on predicting hash function behavior. In order to have an effect this must be called before parsing has started. Returns XML_TRUE if successful, XML_FALSE when called after XML_Parse or XML_ParseBuffer or when parser is NULL.

Note: Setting a salt that is not from a source of high quality entropy (like getentropy(3)) will make the parser vulnerable to hash flooding attacks.

Note: This call is optional, as the parser will auto-generate a new random salt value internally if no value has been set by the start of parsing.

harness_evidence.quote:
// 16-byte deterministic hash key.
static unsigned char hash_key[16] = "FUZZING IS FUN!";

cmake .. -DEXPAT_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DEXPAT_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DEXPAT_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DEXPAT_BUILD_DOCS=OFF \
  -DEXPAT_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$CC -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$CXX >/dev/null
make -j2 expat
LIB=$(find . -name 'libexpat*.a' | head -1)
for f in ../fuzz/xml_parse_fuzzer.c ../fuzz/xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer.c; do
  [ -f $f ] || continue
  b=$(basename $f .c)
  $CC $CFLAGS -DENCODING_FOR_FUZZING=UTF-8 -I../lib -I. -c $f -o $b.o && \
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS $b.o -o $OUT/${b}_UTF-8 $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $LIB

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: XML parsing with a full 16-byte hash salt supplied through XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes or generated automatically.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Before parsing, configure a high-quality 16-byte salt or leave the salt unset for automatic generation.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: ParseOneInput derives an unsigned-long salt from the input and calls XML_SetHashSalt before XML_Parse.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: If that derived value is nonzero, parsing cannot use a full 16-byte salt on that input.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: All root and child parser routes use ParseOneInput. A zero derived value may enable automatic generation, but does not cover the frozen nonzero condition.
